subject.title: fix(memory): exclude extraPaths from shared scope hash to avoid unnecessary reindexing

question: Should same-workspace memory-source agents share one SQLite store by default, and what migration plus session-visibility contract must land with that storage boundary?
rationale: The patch changes persistent storage identity and possible session visibility boundaries, and automation cannot choose whether workspace directory should be the only access boundary for session-indexed memory.

options.title: Require contract and migration before merge
options.body: Keep this PR open but require an explicit upgrade path, CLI/tool session-filter proof, and a settled SDK/schema surface before changing the default store path.

options.title: Accept workspace as the boundary
options.body: Maintainers can approve same-workspace sharing as the security model, but the PR should document that choice and still prove migration and latest-head behavior.

options.title: Keep per-agent default for now
options.body: Pause this branch and keep the canonical shared-index issue open for a narrower opt-in or redesigned shared-store proposal.

recommendation.title: Require contract and migration before merge
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open but require an explicit upgrade path, CLI/tool session-filter proof, and a settled SDK/schema surface before changing the default store path.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses memory runtime, plugin SDK, and storage architecture surfaces where path history shows the strongest repeated ownership signal.
